notes.title: New novella released!
notes.content:
We have great news! After a long break, our team has released a new visual novel in the otome genre! The characters are drawn in anime style, there are beautiful backgrounds, 2 love lines, and also a cool plot twist in one of the branches.
Trap for the Heir - the main character is an experienced werewolf mercenary. One day, she gets a simple and very lucrative order. But who is her mysterious customer? And will it be so easy to get to the destination alive? New friends, old enemies and maybe a meeting with love... Or maybe the promised hundred gold pieces are to blame?! 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1690000/Trap_for_the_Heir/?beta=0]Go to the Trap for the Heir game page[/url]

notes.title: Update
notes.content: In connection with the correction of some errors, we had to partially rewrite the game code. Older save may not work. It is recommended to go through the story from the beginning (you can use the quick skip). We apologize for the temporary inconvenience
